checkedAlternates.risk: Higgs boson is a boson like photons and gluons.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Higgs is a spin-0 scalar boson (group-1), whereas photon and gluon are spin-1 gauge force carriers (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Proton is paired with electron in basic atomic structure.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Protons are composite hadrons made of quarks (group-4), whereas electrons are elementary leptons (group-3).
